backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, touched files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing brief summaries of all frontend source files.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Guide explaining deployment steps and domain options for hosting the Smart Salon site.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining the dark luxury theme colors, typography, and utilities.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with SEO metadata and Smart Salon favicon/icon links.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping the LandingPage in dark mode.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication and identity lifecycle management.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Full landing page UI with hero, about section, features, screenshots, and footer.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended theme tokens, custom colors, fonts, shadows, and keyframes for UI components.
project_state.json: Defines the project’s state, requirements, layout rules, theme guidelines, and feature specifications for a dark luxury Smart Salon landing page.
